items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: My brother was a drummer way before my time, you know, and I come right behind him.

ctx.x: Same church, Thompson and Me Chapel, St. Rock and St. Claude. And that's all my family I know, the musicals. Were there very much stuff there with stuff

My brother was a drummer way before my time, you know, and I come right behind him. That was way back in 1919 and 1920. He played with different bands around here like Lewis, you know, and Kid René and all of them. And I just took the style behind him, pick it up behind him. He gave it up in the late 20s. Sam, he gave it up, yeah.
Did you ever try to play on his drums when you were in the middle?
